items.quote: The advantages for Edson Barboza is he has so much experience. He's fought so many elites has Edson Barboza.

items.quote: And he's a better kickboxer than Ribovics.

items.claim: Edson Barboza is in his 40s and beyond washed.
items.quote: Edson's in his 40s and he's beyond washed. Yeah, Edson Barboza is 40 years old.

items.quote: I'm going to go with Esteban Ribovics by TKO in the second round.
